title: New York – Investors Still In Love With Growth Stocks Risk Losing Out On Value
text:
Posted By Psycho On Mar 15, 2018 America , Israel , News 
New York — A long rally in technology stocks has left investors thirsting for more, but that could be a mistake as the strengthening U.S. economy points to better value in other stocks. Heavyweights like Apple <AAPL.O>, Alphabet <GOOGL.O> and Facebook <FB.O> have especially helped growth indexes in the past year rise more than value […]
